# Research

> Structured AI-driven research sessions. Design research structures, conduct interactive Q&A sessions, manage tasks, build visual roadmaps, create cross-referenced knowledge entries, and track progress.

## Data Model

```
Research (R1, R2...) — statuses: active, completed, archived
  |-- Section (S1, S2...) — logical topics within a research
  |     |-- Entry (E1, E2...) — markdown documents with findings
  |
  |-- Session (SS1, SS2...) — interactive Q&A interview (multiple per research)
  |     |-- Question (Q1, Q2...) — structured prompts with answers
  |
  |-- Task (T1, T2...) — todo items for tracking work
  |
  |-- Roadmap (RM1, RM2...) — visual graphs for learning paths, strategy maps, step-by-step guides
  |     |-- Node (N1, N2...) — graph nodes with type, status, and content
  |     |-- Edge — directed connections between nodes with labels
  |
  Entry -?-> Session — optional link (session_id tracks which session produced the entry)
  Entry --[[E3]]--> Entry — cross-references form a knowledge graph
```

Cross-references (`[[E3]]`, `[[R2:E5]]`, `[[R2]]`) work in entry content, question text, question answers, task results, and session notes. They are rendered as clickable links in the web UI and stored in the `crossrefs` table for graph queries.

A research can have **multiple sessions** (e.g. initial exploration, deep-dive, follow-up). Each session has its own set of questions. Sessions are displayed grouped in the mindmap and listed on the research detail page.

## Docs

- [Domain Guide](/llms/domain-guide.md): Complete reference for every entity (Research, Section, Entry, Session, Question, Task, Roadmap, CrossRef). Describes fields, statuses, relationships, lifecycle, and when to use each entity. Includes tagging strategy, cross-reference syntax, and tips.
- [Conducting Research](/llms/conducting-research.md): Step-by-step guide on how to initialize, conduct, and complete a research project. Interview workflow, entry creation with cross-references, task tracking, roadmap creation, and best practices.
- [Tasks](/llms/tasks.md): Guide to using tasks for tracking work items, action items, and outcomes within a research. When to create tasks, statuses, priorities, tasks vs questions, and best practices.
- [Roadmaps](/llms/roadmaps.md): Guide to building visual directed graphs — learning paths, strategy maps, decision trees. When to create roadmaps, node/edge types, custom statuses by domain, how to build a graph step by step, and best practices.
- [Export](/llms/export.md): How to export research data as markdown documents or PDF. API endpoint reference and web UI export page.
- [REST API — OpenAPI Specification](/api/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 spec for all REST endpoints with request/response schemas.
